2034-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
2034-5254-8122.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
2034-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

4247-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
4247-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat from step 4.

6495-7430--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gorma.
Resolve the persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
6495-7430--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

23-625-1651-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Vandal to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Orcish Vandal by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Vandal.
Repeat from step 2.

433-5233-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

1061-4428-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Thassa.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2103-3277-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and exiling Ephemerate.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-4518-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher
Repeat.
997-4518-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-4871-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2438-4871-5220-5651.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2366-5234-5702-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5234-5702-6965.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-3490-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-3490-4268.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

104-1874-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1874-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

486-1651-4702-4891.description:
Turn Atsushi into an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4002-5159.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Sceptre of Eternal Glory that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.

1669-2034-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-2034-3234-3293.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
1669-2034-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1286-2292-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-4050-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
1636-4050-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {G/U}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

4506-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
4506-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

104-589-2428.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-589-2428.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-2557-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1887-2793-5089-5902-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting four loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

650-710-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1447-2719-5686.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-3859-5115-5283.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
2060-3859-5115-5283.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1939-3197-4017.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
1939-3197-4017.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

976-2498-3260-4435.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
{B} or an additional 2 life available.
976-2498-3260-4435.description:
Activate Greed by paying {B/P} and 2 life, causing you to draw two cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 8 life.
Repeat.

57-232-283-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-232-283-2534.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Coercive Recruiter.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
The token Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 1, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
The token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

396-2034-2557-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
396-2034-2557-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
The nontoken creature enters the battlefield, triggering Blessed Sanctuary, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Unicorn tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1475-2034-4955.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Grafted Wargear attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
1475-2034-4955.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Grafted Wargear attached, adding {C}{C}.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

2034-3081-5003.notablePrerequisites: Any Cleric creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
2034-3081-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orah, adding {C}{C}.
When Orah dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve Orah's trigger, returning any Cleric card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
With Nim Deathmantle's trigger still on the stack, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the returned Cleric, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying {4} to return Orah from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to them.
Repeat.

953-1139-1371.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Enter the Infinite.
Resolve each Enter the Infinite, causing each player to draw their entire library, put a card from their hand on top of their library, and have no maximum hand size until their next turn.
At the beginning of each opponent's draw step, Howling Mine triggers, causing them to draw an additional card and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
